name: Julen De La Serna
title: Julen De La Serna · Filmmaker and cinematographer in the Basque Country
description: Portfolio of Julen De La Serna: music videos, documentaries and other pieces shot and produced from Vitoria-Gasteiz, Basque Country.

about.lead: My passion is creating content that conveys experiences. Stories to be told.
body: For the past 10 years I've worked in the industry, always inside agencies and production companies.
This site is something else. It's my personal project: a home for the work that's mine, and a truer reflection of what I make when the story is my own.
about.photoAlt: Julen De La Serna holding a cinema camera

services.title: Ready
services.text: It all starts with a good story. Storytelling with broad experience behind it.

services.title: Set
services.text: Motion graphics, 2D-3D animation and compositing. Workflows in After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro and Cinema 4D.

services.title: Action
services.text: Own shooting gear and know-how from the latest brands in the industry: RED, Blackmagic, Sony, Freefly, DJI.
